name: Keimoes
terms: Wine of Origin, region, district, ward, estate

South Africa's appellation system since 1973, nested from regions down to districts and wards. A ward is roughly a European appellation. An estate wine may come from neighboring farms farmed and made together.
A red blend with 30 to 70% Pinotage, set by the industry rather than by law. Since the 2019 vintage Pinotage should be its largest part.
